bug: Pagination for audit logs imports a nonexistent OptimizedCursorPaginator / negative slice offsets
why: Matches golden 0/3: the negative-offset branch assigns start_offset = cursor.offset and slices the queryset with it (line 882); the import named in the description is real at head.

bug: Negative offset cursor bypasses pagination bounds during span buffer insert
why: The described negative-offset bypass is the paginator change, not the span buffer insert: the span-buffer files (add-buffer.lua, buffer.py, factory.py) have no cursor or offset logic; the defect is start_offset = cursor.offset fed to queryset slicing.

bug: Upsampled error count skips sample_rate of 0.0 because it is treated as falsy
why: Same as golden 0: the truthiness check `if client_sample_rate:` drops a 0.0 sample rate.

bug: Null reference when github_authenticated_user state is missing (OAuth change)
why: Same as golden 0: the github_authenticated_user state is fetched and compared with no presence check.

bug: Replays bulk delete changes the error response format, breaking clients
why: The description does not match the replays bulk-delete code (replays/usecases/delete.py only adds a None max_segment_id guard); the error response change in this PR is the browser reporting collector, which now answers an invalid report with a 422 JSON body {'error', 'details'} where the base code raised a TypeError (500) from BrowserReport(**report).

bug: Inconsistent metric tag names ('shard' vs 'shards') in span buffer monitoring
why: Same as golden 0: 'shards' tag on wait_produce versus 'shard' on the other flusher metrics.

bug: Dataclass uses a shared mutable default for a timestamp
why: Same as golden 0: the dataclass default timezone.now() is evaluated once at class definition and shared by all instances.

bug: Incident creation reads a stale config variable instead of the updated one
why: Same as golden 0: the context returns the original monitor.config instead of the updated config copy.

bug: Queue-based parallelism mishandles the queue.ShutDown exception
why: The second except queue.ShutDown wraps result_processor, which never raises it, so it is dead code; ShutDown only comes from work_queue.get() (line 132), and FixedQueuePool.shutdown sets worker.shutdown = True before q.shutdown(immediate=False), so workers leave the loop without draining queued items. It is unclear which part the description means; line 142 is the misplaced handler.

bug: Occurrence hook in stateful detector is an incomplete stub (only pass)
why: Same as golden 0: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is a stub containing only `pass`.

bug: Race condition in device creation/update (anonymous device limit), CreateOrUpdateDevice
why: Check-then-insert race: the device count and the upsert are separate, unsynchronized DB operations.

bug: Authz cache entries lack expiration, causing permanent permission denials
why: Denials written to permDenialCache (line 154) short-circuit Check at line 117 and are never invalidated when permissions change; note the cache does get shortCacheTTL (30s) in NewService line 85, so 'no expiration' is overstated and the defensible defect is the stale-denial short-circuit in Check.

bug: Undefined endpoint constants after middleware rename cause compile errors
why: Unsure: the endpoint constants used by the new middleware (lines 40, 45, 50, 55) are in fact defined in clientmiddleware/utils.go at head, so no compile error is visible; these uses are the closest match to the described defect.

bug: Double interpolation risk in query processing
why: Queries are interpolated with applyTemplateVariables before splitting, then interpolated again when datasource.runQuery calls super.query (DataSourceWithBackend applies template variables); same pattern in shardQuerySplitting.ts line 52.

bug: Missing key prop causes React rendering issues in notification rules
why: GrafanaRuleListItem in the mapped list is missing its key prop.

bug: Wrong metrics recording methods produce misleading performance data
why: Wrong recorder used: storage failures recorded via recordLegacyDuration in Create (45) and Update (129), and legacy DeleteCollection recorded via recordStorageDuration (166).

bug: Incorrect error log level in database optimizations
why: Error log level used for routine debug information in the annotation cleanup batches.

bug: Possible deadlock during concurrent annotation deletion
why: Unsure: this PR only changes GetWebAssets locking (no annotation deletion code, and the RLock/Lock sequence cannot deadlock); the description matches PR 7's annotation cleanup, so there is no location in this PR.

bug: enableSqlExpressions always returns false, disabling SQL functionality
why: enableSqlExpressions returns false whether or not the feature flag is enabled.

bug: Race condition in cache locking (unified storage)
why: Narrowing the cacheMu lock in BuildIndex to the cache write leaves index construction unsynchronized.

bug: Async callbacks in forEach cause unhandled promise rejections (appStore import)
why: forEach(async (bookingRef) => { await getCalendar(...) }) leaves the promises unawaited, causing unhandled rejections (same as golden 1; also wipemycalother reschedule.ts:125, bookings.tsx:553, handleCancelBooking.ts:460).

bug: 2FA backup codes are not invalidated after use
why: A used backup code is invalidated only by a non-atomic read-modify-write of the encrypted list, so it is not reliably invalidated after use (concurrent reuse, as in golden 3); the disable endpoint clears all codes, so login is the only place this applies.

bug: Null reference when destinationCalendar host array is empty
why: const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [] is undefined for an empty array, and mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration is then read without a guard; the Google createEvent/updateEvent destructuring named in golden 0 is listed too.

bug: SQL injection risk in raw Prisma.sql query construction (InsightsBookingService)
why: WHERE fragments are now built as raw Prisma.sql strings from filter and option values (first at line 106); Prisma.sql binds the interpolated values as parameters, so the injection risk is nominal, and the location is ambiguous across all four build* methods.

bug: Workflow reminders not cleaned up from DB when immediateDelete is true
why: With immediateDelete true, the function returns after the SendGrid cancel and never removes the WorkflowReminder from the DB.

bug: End time computed from slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime
why: const end = slotStartTime.hour() * 60 + slotStartTime.minute() uses the slot start time where the slot end time is needed.

bug: Timing attack from direct string comparison in OAuth credential sync
why: The webhook secret header is compared to CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET with !==, a non-constant-time comparison open to timing attacks.

bug: OR condition in SMS reminder logic deletes all workflow reminders
why: The retryCount OR condition in deleteMany is not limited to SMS reminders, so it deletes workflow reminders of every method.

bug: Email blacklist is case-sensitive, allowing bypass (guest management)
why: The guest email is compared case-sensitively against the lowercased blacklist, allowing a bypass.

bug: Unreliable updatedAt field produces inaccurate calendar cache status
why: The updatedAt refresh relies on an updateMany with empty data, so the timestamp shown as cache status is unreliable (same as golden 0).

bug: Passkey re-auth calls ConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without UserModel
why: Re-authentication check calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without the UserModel parameter it requires (should pass context.getUser()).

bug: Recursive caching call uses session instead of delegate (getForLogin)
why: getForLogin loads each cached IdP via session.identityProviders().getById (the caching layer itself) rather than idpDelegate.getById.

bug: Returns default keystore provider instead of BouncyCastle (AuthzClientCryptoProvider)
why: Returns KeyStore.getInstance(KeyStore.getDefaultType()).getProvider() (default keystore provider) instead of a BouncyCastle provider.

bug: Incorrect method call for exit codes in rolling-updates framework
why: Exit code for the disabled rolling-updates feature is returned with picocli.exit(...), which hard-exits via System.exit; same call duplicated in UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.run.

bug: Inconsistent feature flag causes orphaned permissions (Client scopes)
why: Permission cleanup listener checks the V1 ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ flag while the rest of the code uses V2, leaving orphaned permissions when only V2 is on.

bug: Incorrect permission check in canManage() (Groups scopes)
why: canManage() accepts the VIEW scope as well as MANAGE when falling back to the all-groups permission.

bug: Lithuanian translation files contain Italian text
why: Translation file (no method): Lithuanian totpStep1 set to Italian text; also login/messages/messages_lt.properties line 71.

bug: Wrong parameter in null check (grantType vs. rawTokenId)
why: Null check passes grantType where rawTokenId was intended, so a null rawTokenId is accepted.

bug: Unsafe raw List deserialization in recovery key support
why: JsonSerialization.readValue(..., List.class) yields a raw List passed unchecked to createFromValues(List<String>...); isValid repeats it with a raw `List generatedKeys` at line 332-334.

bug: Missing null check causes NullPointerException in concurrent group access
why: Concurrent-deletion path in getSubGroupsCount; this PR's head equals upstream commit 332c9b6e so nothing was injected, and the closest match is this null return (sibling getSubGroupsStream overloads at 256/262/268 still call modelSupplier.get() unchecked).

bug: Method overwriting causes parameter mismatch (image downsizing)
why: Same defect as golden 0: the second downsize definition overwrites the max_width/max_height one, so the parameter lists no longer match the callers.

bug: Nil reference to a nonexistent TopicUser (per-topic unsubscribe)
why: Same as golden 0: unsubscribe dereferences tu without checking that the TopicUser record exists.

bug: BlockedEmail.should_block? writes to the DB during a read
why: Same as golden 0: should_block? saves match statistics during what callers use as a read-only check.

bug: SSRF via open(url) without validation (embed URLs)
why: Matches golden 0: open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) with no validation. TopicEmbed.import_remote also calls open(url) on the embed URL (topic_embed.rb line 48), but TopicRetriever.invalid_host? checks that host first.

bug: float: left mixed with flexbox causes header layout issues
why: Same as golden 0: float: left kept inside the new flexbox header layout (.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper); SCSS, no methods.

bug: String mutation via the << operator in URL display
why: website_name uses "." << website_host, which mutates the string literal in place instead of concatenating with + or interpolation.

bug: scale-color $lightness should use $secondary for dark themes
why: The greptile line restates the PR title rather than a defect; the most defensible bug is the light-theme value inverted to 70% at .topic-meta-data h5 a (golden 0/3). SCSS, no methods.

bug: Race conditions in async group member loading
why: Same as golden 0: findMembers is fired asynchronously from setupController with no promise handling.

bug: Thread-safety issue with lazy @loaded_locales
why: Same as golden 0: @loaded_locales ||= [] in ensure_loaded! is not thread-safe.

bug: NoMethodError in before_validation of EmbeddableHost
why: Same as golden 0: host.sub! in before_validation raises NoMethodError when host is nil.
